T_solution:
import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()
n = int(data[0])

x, y = 0, 0
dx, dy = 0, -1
for _ in range(n):
    x, y = x + dx, y + dy
    dx, dy = -dy, dx + dy

print(x, y)
